2.最终确定阶段：采用逼真的 Illustrious/Pony 混合模型以及 ControlNet 指导，实现逼真的输出

The HiFi-Render workflow is a sophisticated two-stage image enhancement system built in ComfyUI that transforms low-quality input images into high-fidelity realistic renders. This workflow leverages the complementary strengths of different AI models to achieve superior results:

1.Draft Stage: Uses NoobAI anime-style model for initial composition and structure

2.Finalization Stage: Employs realistic Illustrious/Pony hybrid models with ControlNet guidance for photorealistic output

The workflow is particularly valuable for dataset creation, as it generates both high-quality images and comprehensive hybrid captions combining Booru tags with natural language descriptions and style modifiers.
